name: Ena Naru
occupation: Animal Healer / Herbal Caretaker / Livestock Medic
residence: Husbandry District (near animal pens and herb gardens)
personality: notices small physical changes others ignore
quietly skeptical of ritual explanations for physical problems
daily_routine: assisting Roka with herd health checks
collecting medicinal plants from forest edges
advising farmers on animal-related agricultural issues

goals.public_goal: Maintain health of livestock population and reduce preventable injury and disease while stabilizing herd productivity across seasons
goals.hidden_goal: Document patterns of recurring injuries tied to specific locations or seasons
goals.deep_goal: Understand why some injuries heal unusually fast—or not at all—in certain areas of the village

beliefs: Most bad luck has physical causes
The body reveals truth faster than speech
Animals are early warning systems for environmental change
Healing is about patterns, not miracles
Some places in the village subtly affect health outcomes
